en.tip_lead: Send a tip about crypto, bitcoin or blockchain in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland or Iceland. A link to a story we missed belongs here. So does anything else you want the newsroom to see.
en.tip_intro: When the inbox is open, the tip goes to Nordic Crypto's private inbox. It is not sent to GitHub, and it is not published. The editorial team reads it. The team includes human editors and an editor that is artificial intelligence. The artificial intelligence is not a human. A tip does not guarantee publication, and we do not reply to every tip. When we publish a story, we link to the original source and write a short summary in our own words. How we work:
en.tip_privacy: When the inbox is open, we follow Vær Varsom-plakaten on protecting sources. Contact is optional. We do not publish who sent a tip, and you do not have to give your name. If you want to stay unnamed, leave contact empty and do not put your name in the tip. We store the tip text, this page's language, the page address, the time, any contact you choose to give, and any attachment links. We do not store your IP address in the tip database. For spam protection we keep only a short-lived scrambled code (a hash) derived from the address, and we delete that code within 10 minutes. The form is received by Cloudflare. A Cloudflare Turnstile check runs when you send, to block spam. Do not include anything you would not want the editorial team to read.
en.tip_hint: Write the tip in your own words. You can include a link to a story here or under attachment links. At most 8000 characters.
en.tip_links_opt: (optional, one http or https link per line, at most 10). Links only. Files cannot be uploaded.
en.tip_contact_opt: (optional, never published). How we can reach you if you want a reply. Leave this empty to stay unnamed.
en.tip_thanks: Thank you. Your tip is in the private inbox. It is not public. The editorial team will read it, including human editors and an editor that is artificial intelligence. The artificial intelligence is not a human. We do not reply to every tip, and a tip is not a promise of publication.
en.tip_fail: The tip could not be sent. Nothing was published. Please try again.
en.tip_offline: The private tip inbox is not answering. Nothing was sent to GitHub. Please try again later.
en.tip_rate: Too many tips from you in a short time. Please try again later.
en.tip_bad_link: Each attachment must be a full http or https link.
en.tip_onion_page: This is the Tor tip page for Nordic Crypto. It does not use JavaScript, external fonts, or analytics. The tip goes to the same private inbox as the website form. Nothing is sent to GitHub.
en.tip_onion_queued: The private inbox could not be reached just now. Your tip is stored only on this onion server and will be forwarded when the inbox answers. It is not public.

sw.tip_lead: Send a tip about crypto, bitcoin or blockchain in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland or Iceland. A link to a story we missed belongs here. So does anything else you want the newsroom to see.
sw.tip_intro: When the inbox is open, the tip goes to Nordic Crypto's private inbox. It is not sent to GitHub, and it is not published. The editorial team reads it. The team includes human editors and an editor that is artificial intelligence. The artificial intelligence is not a human. A tip does not guarantee publication, and we do not reply to every tip. When we publish a story, we link to the original source and write a short summary in our own words. How we work:
sw.tip_privacy: When the inbox is open, we follow Vær Varsom-plakaten on protecting sources. Contact is optional. We do not publish who sent a tip, and you do not have to give your name. If you want to stay unnamed, leave contact empty and do not put your name in the tip. We store the tip text, this page's language, the page address, the time, any contact you choose to give, and any attachment links. We do not store your IP address in the tip database. For spam protection we keep only a short-lived scrambled code (a hash) derived from the address, and we delete that code within 10 minutes. The form is received by Cloudflare. A Cloudflare Turnstile check runs when you send, to block spam. Do not include anything you would not want the editorial team to read.
sw.tip_hint: Write the tip in your own words. You can include a link to a story here or under attachment links. At most 8000 characters.
sw.tip_links_opt: (optional, one http or https link per line, at most 10). Links only. Files cannot be uploaded.
sw.tip_contact_opt: (optional, never published). How we can reach you if you want a reply. Leave this empty to stay unnamed.
sw.tip_thanks: Thank you. Your tip is in the private inbox. It is not public. The editorial team will read it, including human editors and an editor that is artificial intelligence. The artificial intelligence is not a human. We do not reply to every tip, and a tip is not a promise of publication.
sw.tip_fail: The tip could not be sent. Nothing was published. Please try again.
sw.tip_offline: The private tip inbox is not answering. Nothing was sent to GitHub. Please try again later.
sw.tip_rate: Too many tips from you in a short time. Please try again later.
sw.tip_bad_link: Each attachment must be a full http or https link.
sw.tip_onion_page: This is the Tor tip page for Nordic Crypto. It does not use JavaScript, external fonts, or analytics. The tip goes to the same private inbox as the website form. Nothing is sent to GitHub.
sw.tip_onion_queued: The private inbox could not be reached just now. Your tip is stored only on this onion server and will be forwarded when the inbox answers. It is not public.
